notes.title: Beta v 1.2.3.d
notes.notes:
New Features:

Introducing [b]15 new substance dealers and buyers[/b], strategically scattered throughout the city, subway, and park. Keep your eyes peeled for new opportunities and challenges in your underground dealings.

Earl, the notorious underground figure, now offers his own series of missions for you to undertake. Are you ready to dive deeper into the world of clandestine operations?

After successfully completing the "Run Down" mission, a lucrative new deal becomes available in your neighborhood.

Updates:

A new NPC with a mission awaits you on the corner of your neighbor, near the vacant pharmacy. Explore this new avenue of gameplay and see what secrets lie in wait.

Bug Fixes:

Addressed several minor issues and optimizations to improve overall game stability and performance.

notes.title: Beta v1.2.3
notes.notes:
[b]Raffle Vouchers![/b]
Introducing a thrilling addition to your gaming experience - Raffle Vouchers! These vouchers allow players to unlock random loot of a specific rarity from an extensive loot pool featuring over 300 items. Will you be the lucky one to snag that elusive epic item? Raffle vouchers can be earned through gameplay achievements or purchased at Good Pharmacy.

[b]New Mission[/b]
A brand-new mission awaits players. O.F Jane is located outside of Apparel clothing. 

[b]Stat-Boosting Drinks at the Bar![/b]
Head over to the bartender and explore a selection of beverages that can give your character that extra edge in battles. Choose wisely and enhance your stats strategically.

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b]
General optimizations and enhancements for better performance.

notes.title: January 18 - Patch 1
notes.notes:
[b]Game Expansion:[/b]
Unveiled a new play area Cut and Shoot, larger than both Pound Town 1 and 2 combined. Access the new map by boarding the train.

[b]Train Station Substance Dealing Missions:[/b]
Introduced a new mission type, "Substance Dealing," featuring two distinct NPC Substance buyers located randomly within the Roscoe St. Train Station.

[b]Wider Range of Items:[/b]
Enriched inventory with new additions, including clothing, weapons, and substances.

[b]Resolved major/minor bugs affecting overall gameplay experience.[/b]

notes.title: December 30th - Patch 1
notes.notes:
[b]Firearm Arsenal Expansion:[/b]
Introduced additional guns to diversify the in-game arsenal, providing players with exciting new options for combat engagements.

[b]Lowered Level Requirements for Uzi and Shotgun:[/b]
Reduced the level requirements for wielding Uzi and Shotgun, making these weapons accessible at level 9 instead of the previous level 22. Empower your character with these tools earlier in your journey.

[b]Weapon Catalog Overhaul:[/b]
Undertook a comprehensive update of weapon names and descriptions for a clearer, more immersive understanding of each firearm's characteristics and functionality.

[b]Expanded Firearm Selection:[/b]
Broadened the array of available guns in the game, offering players a wider selection of tools to tailor their combat strategy to their preferred playstyle.

notes.title: Dec 28 2023 - patch 1
notes.notes:
[b]Expanded Play Area - Money Bank: [/b]
Unveiled the new Money Bank, located in Pound Town adjacent to the closed Pawn Shop, offering players an exciting new locale to explore and conquer.

[b]New Enemy Type - Security:[/b]
Introduced a new enemy type, "Security," to challenge players in and around the Money Bank. Defeating Security enemies yields new loot drops, including N.Y Boots and credit cards.

[b]Bank Tailor NPC:[/b]
Added a new NPC, the Bank Tailor, stationed within the Money Bank

[b]Fashionable Additions to Neighborhood Apparel:[/b]
Expanded the wardrobe with new clothing options available at Neighborhood Apparel, allowing players to stay stylish while navigating the game world.

[b]Dock Road Redesign for Improved Traffic Flow:[/b]
Overhauled Dock roads to mitigate major crashes, ensuring smoother navigation and improved overall gameplay experience.

[b]Dock Operator Boss Upgrade:[/b]
Completely upgraded the appearance of the Dock Operator boss, introducing new loot drops to reward victorious players.

[b]New Loot Drops for Dock Staff and Dock Manager:[/b]
Enemies Dock Staff and Dock Manager now have new loot drops, providing additional incentives for engaging and defeating them.

[b]Balancing Adjustments in Pound Town Bar:[/b]
Reduced the presence of enemies, civilians, and security personnel in the Pound Town Bar 2 for enhanced skill balance and optimization.

[b]Shoulder Armor Inventory Bug Fix:[/b]
Resolved a bug preventing shoulder armor from appearing in the inventory, ensuring a seamless and accurate representation of the player's equipment.

notes.title: Dec 27 2023 - patch 1
notes.notes:
[b]Neighborhood Appeal Upgrade:[/b]
Introduced Glo Merch to enhance the neighborhood's appeal, providing players with new cosmetic options to showcase their allegiance.

[b]Armor Expansion:[/b]
Added a range of new armor options, including shoulder pads, helmets, and spiked armor, now available as drops from enemies. Additionally, players can purchase these items at the Neighborhood Appeal for added convenience.

notes.title: Dec 25 2023 - patch 1
notes.notes:
[b]Expanded Play Area - Ultimate Man Hideout:[/b]
Introducing a new playable area with the addition of a Ultimate Man Hideout, offering players exciting challenges and opportunities for loot.

[b]Loot Enrichment - Ultimate Man Hideout:[/b]
Diversified the loot system by incorporating new items, providing players with a broader range of options and rewards.

[b]Alley NPC Integration with Missions:[/b]
Introduced three new non-playable characters (NPCs) strategically placed in alleys, offering unique missions to further engage players in Paper Works narrative.

[b]Enemy NPC Diversity:[/b]
Added two new enemy NPCs to enhance combat dynamics, each possessing distinct abilities and loot to keep gameplay fresh and challenging.

notes.title: Dec 24 2023 - patch 1
notes.notes:
[b]Enemy Reduction in Bar (Located in Pound Town 2):[/b]
Adjusted enemy density in bar environments for a more balanced and enjoyable gameplay experience.

[b]Road Overhaul for Major Crashes:[/b]
Comprehensive redesign of roads to minimize major crashes and improve overall travel flow within Pound Town 1 &2.

[b]Loot Pool Adjustments:[/b]
Fine-tuned loot pools for various existing items, enhancing the variety of drops for a more diverse item selection.

[b]New Enemy: Piper Boy[/b]
Introduced new enemy Piper Boy, to add fresh challenges and encounters throughout the game Pound Town

[b]Axe Functionality Bug Fix:[/b]
Resolved a bug that was preventing the proper functioning of the axe, ensuring seamless gameplay for players relying on this weapon.

[b]Intro Video Temporarily Removed:[/b]
Temporarily disabled the intro video to streamline the initial game launch experience.

[b]Loading Screen Game Tips:[/b]
Added helpful game tips to the loading screen, providing players with valuable information while the game loads.
